accepted_decisions.summary: Adopt exactly three loops: Decision, Planning, Implementation.
Use gateway gates as loop exit conditions and gate pass as promotion boundary.
Treat compiler as source engine and compiler output/build as telemetry trace data.
Move .codewiki target toward kb plus telemetry, with graph generated and Git cold proof.
Use decision.json, planning.json, implementation.json per trace.
Require KB/diagram propagation or no-impact rationale before semantic pass.
Move source toward loop-first roots and finish daemon/agency first.
